LanguageData.HE_Roma_Standard.label: legion standards
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Standard.description: Weave the red standards of the legions and raise them over your halls.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Concrete.label: Roman concrete
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Concrete.description: Mix lime, volcanic ash and rubble into a concrete that hardens even under water. Unlocks concrete floors.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Smithing.label: legion smithing
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Smithing.description: Forge the gladius, the short sword of the legions.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.label: pilum
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pilum.description:
Make the pilum, a heavy spear with a long iron shank that punches through shields and armor.
Requires 10 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Roads.label: Roman roads
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Roads.description:
Build paved roads that let people walk quickly and caravans travel far.
Tradition: Unlocks Roman road floors. Your caravans travel 10% faster.
Requires 20 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Engineers.label: castrum engineers
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Engineers.description:
Every legionary is also a builder. Each night the legion raises a fortified camp; your colonists learn to build just as quickly.
Tradition: Colonists build 15% faster but mine 5% slower: the legion's tools are made for building, not digging. Unlocks the legion brazier.
Requires 30 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aqueduct.label: aqueducts
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aqueduct.description:
Raise arched aqueducts, the pride of every Roman town.
Requires 40 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Senate.label: senate records
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Senate.description:
Keep careful records of everything your scholars learn about Nova Roma.
Tradition: Studying Nova Roman items gives 25% more knowledge.
Requires 25 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Garum.label: garum and puls
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Garum.description: Learn the kitchen of the legions: thick puls porridge and the fermented fish sauce garum that every Roman table expects.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Cursus.label: cursus honorum
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Cursus.description:
The ladder of public offices: every citizen who wants to lead must first serve, learn and be judged.
Tradition: Colonists learn 8% faster, but the pressure of office raises their mental break threshold by 2%.
Requires 10 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Forum.label: the forum
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Forum.description:
Raise marble statues of great citizens around an open forum.
Requires 10 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lorica.label: lorica segmentata
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lorica.description:
Forge the banded plate armour of the legions and the bronze galea helmet with its red crest. Also teaches the simple wool tunic.
Requires 20 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Thermae.label: thermae
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Thermae.description:
Heated public baths fed by the aqueducts, where citizens wash, gossip and forget their troubles. Also teaches mosaic floors.
Requires 35 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Testudo.label: testudo
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Testudo.description:
The tortoise formation: shields locked above and around, the legion advances slowly but almost nothing gets through.
Tradition: Colonists gain +5% sharp armour but move 3% slower. Unlocks the scutum display.
Requires 40 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Manuballista.label: manuballista
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Manuballista.description:
A hand-held torsion crossbow that throws heavy iron bolts.
Requires 30 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Drill.label: legion drill
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Drill.description:
Endless practice with wooden swords twice as heavy as real ones. When the real fight comes, every thrust lands.
Tradition: Colonists gain +2 melee hit chance.
Requires 35 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pax.label: pax romana
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Pax.description:
Peace through law, trade and the quiet threat of the legions. Nova Roma's envoys are listened to.
Tradition: Colonists gain +10% negotiation ability and +5% social impact.
Requires 45 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aquila.label: the eagle's pride
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aquila.description:
With the eagle found, every citizen stands a little taller.
Tradition: Colonists gain +2 melee hit chance, +1 shooting accuracy and a 2% lower mental break threshold.
Requires 50 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.label: legion carbine
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Carbine.description:
A short breech-loading carbine for the new legions: quick to load, light to carry and easy to fire from behind a shield wall.
Requires 35 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_CivilCode.label: civil code
LanguageData.HE_Roma_CivilCode.description:
Every right and duty written down in one book, from inheritance to the price of grain. Disputes end sooner, though every request now needs a form.
Tradition: Colonists gain +6% negotiation ability and +6% social impact, but work 2% slower.
Requires 45 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio.label: scorpio
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio.description:
The legion's artillery: a bolt thrower small enough to set on a wall, strong enough to pin a man to a tree at three hundred paces.
Requires 40 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_PowderArms.label: Roman powder arms
LanguageData.HE_Roma_PowderArms.description:
The Nova Roma way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Nova Roma has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_SteamArmy.label: Roman steam army
LanguageData.HE_Roma_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Nova Roma raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Nova Roma has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Nova Roman knowledge unless this is your heritage.
